decisions.statement: A route serving this answer has the wiring and no part of the answering.
The group answered for is handed in rather than named here.
The readouts answered for are the ones whose page names the group.
The readouts are answered in the order the place on each page states.
The label answered is the label the readout's own page has.
The key with the wire key is the key the caller names.
A caller naming no key for the wire key has the wire key answered under habit.
The scale read is the scale the readout's page names rather than a scale named here.
The color answered is the rung the reading reaches on that scale.
The reading answered is the number carried in written as a figure is written.
The reading carried in is the reading taken on the machine that took the reading.
Where each reading is read from is handed in rather than settled here.
The stoplight a row makes is worked out from rungs handed in.
A caller with the rungs already works a stoplight out without awaiting.
A caller wanting the colors without a route asks for the group on its own.
A store that refuses the group answers as a group holding nothing answers.
Every readout the group admits is answered as a stoplight.
A readout with no reading is answered as a stoplight carrying no figure.
A reading of zero is a reading rather than an absence.
The color of a stoplight with no figure is the color below every rung.
A stoplight with no figure carries the figure as empty text rather than leaving that figure out.
A stoplight with no figure has no tier above and no fraction climbed.
Whether a reading past either end of its scale draws its figure is read off the group's page.
Whether a figure is drawn past either end is read once for the group rather than once per reading.
A group stating nothing has no reading of its draw a figure past either end.
A group the store withholds is answered as a group stating nothing is answered.
The answer is carried on each stoplight a ring is handed.
A group drawing no figure past either end leaves that off rather than saying no.
A stoplight with a reading says nothing of how that reading is held.
A stoplight whose reading falls with the clock carries the moment taken and the rate.
A stoplight whose reading falls at nothing an hour carries neither.
No stoplight carries when a reading reaches a rung.
A tile with the rungs works out when a reading reaches a rung.
A wait worked out at the moment taken is a wait aimed at the wrong rung later.
A falling stoplight carries the rungs of its scale.
A stoplight that is not falling carries no rungs.
The rungs carried are the ones this answer colored with rather than a scale.
The tier answered is read at the moment taken.
A tile with the rungs reads its own tier.
A readout whose page names no wire key is left out rather than answered keyless.
A readout whose page names no label is left out rather than labelled here.
A readout whose page names no scale is left out rather than colored.
A readout whose page stills the readout is left out rather than answered.
A readout whose page states nothing about being stilled is answered.
Whether a readout is stilled is read off the row rather than asked of the store.
A scale the store withholds leaves its readout out rather than colored.
A group no readout is left in is answered as no reading rather than as empty.
Nothing between here and the tile is allowed to keep an answer.
A store set up for a test answers the rows the answering it was handed gives.
A caller handing no answering over has each page type asked for answered from a branch.
A page type no branch answers is answered with no row.
A store set up for a test puts back the origin that store replaced when the store goes.
A store that goes closes its connections rather than leaving a connection open.
The helpers reading a tile's rings sit in one file rather than in each test.
Relaying one reading and reading the one stoplight back is one helper.
A tile is reached with a ring credential or with none.
A tile asked with a credential of the caller's presents that credential in place of its own.
A tile's readers are bound rather than wrapped, so no test states the wrapper.
The rows a store answers an ask with are the rows that ask names, by slug or by group.
An ask naming neither is answered with every row the store was handed.
The rows a store holds are handed in rather than named here.
A store set up for a test places a page named by page type and slug at a path of its own.
A page no row of that store answers for is placed nowhere rather than at a path.
A store keeps the values a write hands it beside the path that write names.
A row a store answers carries the values written beside that row's own path.
A store set up again holds nothing written to the store before it.
A reading a test relays is kept beside the readout's own path in the store.
A test drops every reading the store holds without setting that store up again.
Nothing here takes a reading.
Nothing here names a readout.
Nothing here names a scale.
Nothing here names a group.
Nothing here names a color.
Nothing here reads a person or a device.
The scale is asked for only where a fresh reading is read against that scale.
A stoplight with no figure says no reading was taken.

definition: what a route answers when a caller asks for a group of readings as colors
